verses.original: Ἴδετε ποταπὴν ἀγάπην δέδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ Πατὴρ ἵνα τέκνα Θεοῦ κληθῶμεν καὶ ἐσμέν διὰ τοῦτο ὁ κόσμος οὐ γινώσκει ἡμᾶς ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνω αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Idete potapēn agapēn dedōken hēmin ho Patēr hina tekna Theou klēthōmen kai esmen dia touto ho kosmos ou ginōskei hēmas hoti ouk egnō auton
verses.literal: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us that we should be called children of God And that is what we are The reason . . . the world does not know us is that it did not know Him
verses.literalPt: Vede que amor o Pai nos tem mostrado, para que fôssemos chamados filhos de Deus; e nós o somos. Por isso, o mundo não nos conhece, porque não o conheceu a ele.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί νῦν τέκνα Θεοῦ ἐσμεν καὶ οὔπω ἐφανερώθη τί ἐσόμεθα οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐὰν φανερωθῇ ὅμοιοι αὐτῷ ἐσόμεθα ὅτι ὀψόμεθα αὐτὸν καθώς ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi nyn tekna Theou esmen kai oupō ephanerōthē ti esometha oidamen hoti ean phanerōthē homoioi autō esometha hoti opsometha auton kathōs estin
verses.literal: Beloved we are now children of God and what we will be has not yet been revealed We know that when Christ appears we will be like Him for we will see Him as He is
verses.literalPt: Amados, agora somos filhos de Deus, e não está ainda manifesto o que havemos de ser. Sabemos que, se ele se manifestar, seremos semelhantes a ele, porque o veremos como ele é.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἔχων τὴν ἐλπίδα ταύτην ἐπ’ αὐτῷ ἁγνίζει ἑαυτὸν καθὼς ἐκεῖνος ἁγνός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: kai pas ho echōn tēn elpida tautēn ep’ autō hagnizei heauton kathōs ekeinos hagnos estin
verses.literal: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself just as Christ is pure
verses.literalPt: Todo o que nele tem esta esperança purifica-se a si mesmo, como ele é puro.

verses.original: Πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν καὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν ποιεῖ καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐστὶν ἡ ἀνομία
verses.transliteration: Pas ho poiōn tēn hamartian kai tēn anomian poiei kai hē hamartia estin hē anomia
verses.literal: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well Indeed sin is lawlessness
verses.literalPt: Todo aquele que comete pecado comete também iniquidade; e o pecado é a iniquidade.

verses.original: καὶ οἴδατε ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ἐφανερώθη ἵνα τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἄρῃ καὶ ἁμαρτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν
verses.transliteration: kai oidate hoti ekeinos ephanerōthē hina tas hamartias arē kai hamartia en autō ouk estin
verses.literal: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins and in Him there is no sin
verses.literalPt: Sabeis que ele se manifestou para tirar os pecados, e nele não há pecado.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ ἐν αὐτῷ μένων οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει πᾶς ὁ ἁμαρτάνων οὐχ ἑώρακεν αὐτὸν οὐδὲ ἔγνωκεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: pas ho en autō menōn ouch hamartanei pas ho hamartanōn ouch heōraken auton oude egnōken auton
verses.literal: No one . . . who remains in Him keeps on sinning No one . . . who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him
verses.literalPt: Todo o que nele permanece não peca; todo o que peca não o tem visto, nem o conhece.

verses.original: Τεκνία μηδεὶς πλανάτω ὑμᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην δίκαιός ἐστιν καθὼς ἐκεῖνος δίκαιός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Teknia mēdeis planatō hymas ho poiōn tēn dikaiosynēn dikaios estin kathōs ekeinos dikaios estin
verses.literal: Little children let no one deceive you The one who practices righteousness is righteous just as Christ is righteous
verses.literalPt: Filhinhos, ninguém vos desencaminhe; quem pratica a justiça é justo, como ele é justo;

verses.original: ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐκ τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστίν ὅτι ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ὁ διάβολος ἁμαρτάνει εἰς τοῦτο ἐφανερώθη ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα λύσῃ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ διαβόλου
verses.transliteration: ho poiōn tēn hamartian ek tou diabolou estin hoti ap’ archēs ho diabolos hamartanei eis touto ephanerōthē ho Huios tou Theou hina lysē ta erga tou diabolou
verses.literal: The one who practices sin is of the devil because the devil has been sinning from the very start This is why . . . the Son of God was revealed to destroy the works of the devil
verses.literalPt: quem comete pecado é do Diabo, porque o Diabo peca desde o princípio. Para destruir as obras do Diabo é que o Filho de Deus se manifestou.

verses.original: Πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἁμαρτίαν οὐ ποιεῖ ὅτι σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ οὐ δύναται ἁμαρτάνειν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ γεγέννηται
verses.transliteration: Pas ho gegennēmenos ek tou Theou hamartian ou poiei hoti sperma autou en autō menei kai ou dynatai hamartanein hoti ek tou Theou gegennētai
verses.literal: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin because God’s seed abides in him he cannot go on sinning because he has been born of God
verses.literalPt: Quem é nascido de Deus não comete pecado, porque a semente de Deus permanece nele; e ele não pode pecar, porque é nascido de Deus.

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ φανερά ἐστιν τὰ τέκνα τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὰ τέκνα τοῦ διαβόλου πᾶς ὁ μὴ ποιῶν δικαιοσύνην οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: en toutō phanera estin ta tekna tou Theou kai ta tekna tou diabolou pas ho mē poiōn dikaiosynēn ouk estin ek tou Theou kai ho mē agapōn ton adelphon autou
verses.literal: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God nor is anyone who does not love his brother
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Deus e os filhos do Diabo nisto são manifestos: todo aquele que não pratica a justiça não é de Deus, nem aquele que não ama a seu irmão.

verses.original: Ὅτι αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Hoti hautē estin hē angelia hēn ēkousate ap’ archēs hina agapōmen allēlous
verses.literal: This is the message you have heard from the beginning We should love one another
verses.literalPt: Pois a mensagem que tendes ouvido desde o princípio é esta: que nos amemos uns aos outros.

verses.original: οὐ καθὼς Κάϊν ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ ἦν καὶ ἔσφαξεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ χάριν τίνος ἔσφαξεν αὐτόν ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρὰ ἦν τὰ δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ δίκαια
verses.transliteration: ou kathōs Kain ek tou ponērou ēn kai esphaxen ton adelphon autou kai charin tinos esphaxen auton hoti ta erga autou ponēra ēn ta de tou adelphou autou dikaia
verses.literal: Do not be like Cain who belonged to . . . the evil one and murdered his brother And why . . . did Cain slay him Because his own deeds were evil while those of his brother were righteous
verses.literalPt: Não sejamos, pois, como Caim, que era do Maligno e matou a seu irmão; e por que o matou? Porque as suas obras eram más, e as de seu irmão, justas.

verses.original: καὶ Μὴ θαυμάζετε ἀδελφοί εἰ μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὁ κόσμος
verses.transliteration: kai Mē thaumazete adelphoi ei misei hymas ho kosmos
verses.literal: So do not be surprised brothers if the world hates you
verses.literalPt: Não vos maravilheis, irmãos, se o mundo vos aborrece.

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι μεταβεβήκαμεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν ὅτι ἀγαπῶμεν τοὺς ἀδελφούς ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν μένει ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis oidamen hoti metabebēkamen ek tou thanatou eis tēn zōēn hoti agapōmen tous adelphous ho mē agapōn menei en tō thanatō
verses.literal: We know that we have passed from death to life because we love our brothers The one who does not love remains in death
verses.literalPt: Nós sabemos que já passamos da morte para a vida, porque amamos os irmãos; quem não ama permanece na morte.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἐστίν καὶ οἴδατε ὅτι πᾶς ἀνθρωποκτόνος οὐκ ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἐν αὐτῷ μένουσαν
verses.transliteration: pas ho misōn ton adelphon autou anthrōpoktonos estin kai oidate hoti pas anthrōpoktonos ouk echei zōēn aiōnion en autō menousan
verses.literal: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer
verses.literalPt: Todo aquele que aborrece a seu irmão é homicida; e sabeis que nenhum homicida tem a vida eterna permanente em si mesmo.

verses.original: Ἐν τούτῳ ἐγνώκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἔθηκεν καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀδελφῶν τὰς ψυχὰς θεῖναι
verses.transliteration: En toutō egnōkamen tēn agapēn hoti ekeinos hyper hēmōn tēn psychēn autou ethēken kai hēmeis opheilomen hyper tōn adelphōn tas psychas theinai
verses.literal: By this we know what love is Jesus laid down His life for us and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers
verses.literalPt: Por isto conhecemos o amor, porque Cristo deu a sua vida por nós; e nós devemos dar a vida pelos irmãos.

verses.original: ὃς δ’ ἂν ἔχῃ τὸν βίον τοῦ κόσμου καὶ θεωρῇ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχοντα καὶ κλείσῃ τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ πῶς ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hos d’ an echē ton bion tou kosmou kai theōrē ton adelphon autou chreian echonta kai kleisē ta splanchna autou ap’ autou pōs hē agapē tou Theou menei en autō
verses.literal: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need but withholds his compassion from him how can the love of God abide in him
verses.literalPt: Mas aquele que tiver bens do mundo, e vir seu irmão em necessidade, e fechar-lhe o seu coração, como permanece nele o amor de Deus?

verses.original: Τεκνία μὴ ἀγαπῶμεν λόγῳ μηδὲ τῇ γλώσσῃ ἀλλὰ ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Teknia mē agapōmen logō mēde tē glōssē alla en ergō kai alētheia
verses.literal: Little children let us love not in word and speech but in action and truth
verses.literalPt: Filhinhos, não amemos de palavra nem de língua, mas por obras e em verdade.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γνωσόμεθα ὅτι ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας ἐσμέν καὶ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πείσομεν τὴν καρδίαν ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai en toutō gnōsometha hoti ek tēs alētheias esmen kai emprosthen autou peisomen tēn kardian hēmōn
verses.literal: And by this we will know that we belong to . . . the truth and will assure our hearts in His presence . . .
verses.literalPt: Nisso conheceremos que somos da verdade e, diante dele, tranquilizaremos o nosso coração,

verses.original: ὅτι ἐὰν καταγινώσκῃ ἡμῶν ἡ καρδία ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ Θεὸς τῆς καρδίας ἡμῶν καὶ γινώσκει πάντα
verses.transliteration: hoti ean kataginōskē hēmōn hē kardia hoti meizōn estin ho Theos tēs kardias hēmōn kai ginōskei panta
verses.literal: Even if our hearts condemn us - God is greater than our hearts and He knows all things
verses.literalPt: a respeito de tudo quanto o nosso coração nos condenar, porque Deus é maior do que o nosso coração e conhece todas as coisas.

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί ἐὰν ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν μὴ καταγινώσκῃ παρρησίαν ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi ean hē kardia hēmōn mē kataginōskē parrēsian echomen pros ton Theon
verses.literal: Beloved if our hearts do not condemn us we have confidence before God
verses.literalPt: Amados, se o nosso coração nos não condenar, temos confiança para com Deus;

verses.original: καὶ ὃ ἐὰν αἰτῶμεν λαμβάνομεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηροῦμεν καὶ τὰ ἀρεστὰ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ποιοῦμεν
verses.transliteration: kai ho ean aitōmen lambanomen ap’ autou hoti tas entolas autou tēroumen kai ta aresta enōpion autou poioumen
verses.literal: and we will receive from Him whatever . . . we ask because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight . . .
verses.literalPt: e tudo o que lhe pedirmos receberemos dele, porque guardamos os seus mandamentos e fazemos o que é agradável aos seus olhos.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ ἵνα πιστεύσωμεν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους καθὼς ἔδωκεν ἐντολὴν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai hautē estin hē entolē autou hina pisteusōmen tō onomati tou Huiou autou Iēsou Christou kai agapōmen allēlous kathōs edōken entolēn hēmin
verses.literal: And this is His commandment that we should believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ and we should love one another just as He commanded us
verses.literalPt: Este é o seu mandamento: que creiamos no nome de seu Filho, Jesus Cristo, e nos amemos uns aos outros, conforme ele nos ordenou.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ τηρῶν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι μένει ἐν ἡμῖν ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος οὗ ἡμῖν ἔδωκεν
verses.transliteration: kai ho tērōn tas entolas autou en autō menei kai autos en autō kai en toutō ginōskomen hoti menei en hēmin ek tou Pneumatos hou hēmin edōken
verses.literal: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God and God in him And by this we know that He remains in us by the Spirit He has given us
verses.literalPt: Quem guarda os seus mandamentos permanece em Deus, e Deus, nele. E nisso conhecemos que ele permanece em nós, pelo Espírito que nos deu.
